summary: Single-behavior creative documentation item: generate and score 30+ rough creature concepts, select the 18-24 organism secret roster, and enforce the section 11.1 distribution and minimums, the <25% swimming-mouth diversity gate, the section 11.2 anti-cliche gate, and section 47 coverage of at least eight principles, all into one deliverable, design_private/creature_candidates.md. Volume is high but the behavior is singular and independently checkable; one subsystem (private design documentation), no code. On-disk file matches the reviewed spec verbatim. Depends correctly on WI-01a (selected world is the upstream input); no ancestor or descendant dependencies, and sibling WI-01c correctly depends back on this node. Parent criteria AC-cp-roster and AC-cp-spoiler are carried verbatim; the shared spoiler criterion is bounded for this node (own artifacts and commit message, commit format spelled out) with WI-01c named final proof owner at the story level. Verification is focused on one file with concrete countable checks. Handoff is self-contained: referenced request sections 11, 13, 21, 46, 47, 52 all exist, the upstream input from WI-01a is named, and per-organism renderer, no-code, and spoiler constraints are recorded inline.
